title: USCGC Bertholf and Stratton Wiper System Parts
agency_path: HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF.US COAST GUARD.SFLC PROCUREMENT BRANCH 2(00085)
detail_text: This is for informational purposes and has been awarded sole source SOW for Wynn System Wiper Parts USCGC BERTHOLF (WMSL-750) / USCGC STRATTON (WMSL-752) This solicitation is to provide: Wynn Wiper System parts for BERTHOLF and STRATTON BERTHOLF WIPER PARTS ITEM DESCRIPTION NSN PN QTY Needed Wynn Type C Twin-Bladed Wiper Assembly, 115VAC, with heater, less motor & controller Drawing No.: Q02495-03 r2 N/A N/A 1 V-Belt, Stroke: 480mm (Windows: 3) N/A IM-DEEP-106-A40 1 V-Belt, Stroke: 710mm (Window: 4) N/A IM-DEEP-106-A58 1 Blade Arm Tension Springs N/A IM-DEEP-157 4 Control Panel, 4-way complete with master, intermittent, heater, and wash/purge controls (Main Pilot House) IM-DEEP-021-10 1 Self-Parking Assembly (Reed Switch and Magnet) IM-DEEP-012 3 STRATTON WIPER PARTS ITEM DESCRIPTION NSN PN QTY Needed Wynn Type C Wiper Assembly, 115VAC, with heater, less motor & controller Drawing No.: Q02495-02 r2 N/A N/A 1 V-Belt, Stroke: 480mm (Windows: 3) N/A IM-DEEP-106-A40 5 V-Belt, Stroke: 710mm (Window: 4) N/A IM-DEEP-106-A58 3 Vendor to ship parts to ships’ homeport: LT Adrian Rubio SFLC LRE PL UNITED STATES COAST GUARD BASE ALAMEDA 1 EAGLE ROAD ALAMEDA, CA 94501 Security requirements: No special security requirements needed. Vendor will only be required to ship parts. POP: 4/21/26 – 6/15/26 POC: BERTHOLF and STRATTON APM: LT Adrian Rubio 657-944-8163
